legal_name: TVH INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (as claimed; not independently verified in MCA/registry records)
note: Registry data could not be retrieved. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection refused; zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403; instafinancials returned 404; Bing results were dominated by the Belgian parent group's own website (tvh.com) and returned no Indian registry profile. The only verified fact: TVH is a global parts distributor (agricultural, construction, industrial, material-handling equipment parts) with an India country page on tvh.com — this indicates a trading/distribution function, not manufacturing, but it is a corporate-website claim, not a registry record. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, registered state, MCA status or audited revenue figures are public in the sources I could reach, so all such fields are null rather than guessed. NOT rejected: no evidence the entity does not exist — absence of retrievable records is a data-access limitation, not proof of non-existence. Recommended follow-up: manual lookup on mca.gov.in (company name search) and GST portal / a GSTIN-lookup aggregator to obtain CIN, PAN (4th character holder type), GSTIN and status, plus Tofler/Instafinancials for FY25/FY26 audited revenue. Note also that declared HS codes 843139/848390 (parts of lifting/handling machinery; gearing/gearboxes) are consistent with a parts trader, and per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground in any case.
